lanes.name: Retail Agent
lanes.hint: Retail/Telesales agent handling the Post to Pre migration request

lanes.name: Retention Agent
lanes.hint: Retention team working the retention ticket and offers

lanes.name: System / CRM
lanes.hint: CRM/order system validations, tracking records, notifications

nodes.label: Validate Q Ticket & Identify Customer
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Trouble Ticket TT-001-JSM-*

nodes.label: Customer Identification
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Trouble Ticket TT-001-CAM-*

nodes.label: Navigation to Customer 360
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Customer 360

nodes.label: Initiate Post to Pre
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to initiate Post to Pre migration process
controls: System shall allow for Migration only for Customer with Service as Mobile and Connection type as Postpaid

nodes.label: Migration Not Allowed
nodes.desc: System shall allow for Migration only for Customer with Service as Mobile and Connection type as Postpaid; otherwise migration cannot be initiated.
controls: System shall allow for Migration only for Customer with Service as Mobile and Connection type as Postpaid

nodes.label: Automatic Tracking Record Creation
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Blacklist and Collection Check
nodes.desc: The system shall perform a blacklist verification for the customer before proceeding the request. The system shall perform a validation to determine whether the customer account is in Collection status or has any outstanding bill balance before proceeding with the request. If the customer has any outstanding bill amount, the outstanding balance must be cleared before the journey can proceed.
controls: Blacklisted customers shall not be eligible for any Post to Pre migration.

nodes.label: Migration Rejected — Blacklisted
nodes.desc: Blacklisted customers shall not be eligible for any Post to Pre migration.
controls: Blacklisted customers shall not be eligible for any Post to Pre migration.

nodes.label: Lock-in Checks and Penalty Charges
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view Plan Lock-in, Star Number Lock-in, and DOI Lock-in details and their respective penalty charges. Depending upon these charges, Agent shall advise the customer for further process.
controls: System shall display Plan Lock-in penalty charges (as per minimum 3 months rule from contract start date)
System shall display Star Number Lock-in penalty charges (as per the star number category from the contract start date)
System shall display DOI Lock-in (installment charges for the remaining months from the contract start date)

nodes.label: Collect Payment
nodes.desc: System shall display Plan Lock-in Period penalty, Star Number Lock-in Period penalty, DOI Remaining Installment charges, Outstanding dues, and Migration Fees. System shall not allow the journey to proceed without collecting the payment.
controls: System shall be able to generate the payment receipt and allow the agent to proceed with the journey.

nodes.label: Raise Retention Ticket
nodes.desc: The agent shall be able to create a Retention ticket for the retention team and it should be assigned to the retention queue.
controls: Reuse Requirement of Ticket Creation - TT-001-CRE-*
Reuse Requirement of Ticket assignment - TT-001-ASG-*

nodes.label: Tracking Record Update
nodes.desc: System shall update the Record ticket with "Resolved" status.

nodes.label: Retention Offers
nodes.desc: System shall allow Retention agent to assign ticket to himself and agent shall start working on it. Agent will follow the ticket assignment process. Retention agent shall provide different retention offers to customer in the form of Discounts or Add-ons.

nodes.label: Retention Offer Accepted?
nodes.desc: Customer accepts Retention offer and Retention agent shall be able to add new Add-on or new discounts; or Customer rejects the offer and asks for Postpaid to Prepaid migration.
controls: Additional add-on and discount shall be sent to downstream systems.
Amount paid by customer will be treated as advance payment and it will be adjusted in future bills.

nodes.label: Cart Creation (Retention)
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to open the Cart and add the Addon Plan or Discount. Plan Change also possible.
controls: System must not allow to modify anything else in the cart except Adding Add On, Adding Discount, Change Base Plan

nodes.label: Cart Checkout (Retention)
nodes.desc: Agent must be able to validate the cart.
controls: System must ensure the latest Discount is made applicable to the cart
Added Add on must be visible during Checkout
Existing Base plan, add on must remain as is.

nodes.label: Automatic Retention Ticket Closure
nodes.desc: System shall close the retention ticket.
controls: Reuse Requirement of Ticket Resolution - TT-001-RES-*

nodes.label: Retention Offer Rejected
nodes.desc: Customer can reject the retention offer and ask for Postpaid to Prepaid migration. Agent shall close the Retention Ticket. Agent shall navigate to Customer 360 and proceed for Post to Pre Migration process from the Retention Ticket Stage.

nodes.label: Cart Creation (Prepaid)
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to create the cart (order) with the prepaid eligible plan. Agent shall be able to add eligible add-ons/discounts to the cart. Agent shall be able to review and modify the selected plans, add-ons before submission.
controls: System shall display the Bill Limit of the plan as blank since customer moving from Post to Pre.
System shall recalculate cart charges, recurring charges, one-time charges, discounts, whenever products are added, modified, or removed from the cart.
System shall display the SIM and MSISDN information and restrict to remove/update it.

nodes.label: Billing Profile Update
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to remove the Postpaid Billing Details already present. Agent shall be able to make the Billing Profile NA for Connection Type Prepaid.
controls: System shall restrict selection of Billing Account for Prepaid Connection Type

nodes.label: Save Milestone
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Validate Cart
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to review and validate before proceeding to payment.
controls: System shall perform all customer, Account, MSISDN, SIM Details, Plan, eligibility, compatibility validations prior to payment initiation.
System shall prevent order progression until all mandatory validations are successfully completed.

nodes.label: Payment Processing
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to view the payment summary before confirming the payment. Agent shall be able to initiate payment through WinCash for the Price of the Base Plan and price for any additional add-ons (not bundled with base plan). Agent shall be able to provide the customer copy of the receipt generated by WinCash (even if customer doesn't need to pay upfront, WinCash will generate receipt for zero payment).
controls: System shall display the payment summary and total payable amount prior to payment processing.
System shall send the upfront payment request to WinCash and update the payment status in CRM based on the response received.
If payment fails, the system shall place the order on hold and return the agent to the payment summary screen for re-attempt.

nodes.label: WinCash Payment Gateway
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to initiate payment through WinCash; WinCash returns payment status and generates the customer receipt.

nodes.label: Order on Hold — Payment Retry
nodes.desc: If payment fails, the system shall place the order on hold and return the agent to the payment summary screen for re-attempt.
controls: If payment fails, the system shall place the order on hold and return the agent to the payment summary screen for re-attempt.

nodes.label: Key Information
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Optional CAF Generation
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to generate the CAF form.

nodes.label: CAF Generate
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: CAF Submission
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Signature Pad
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Supporting Documents
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Save Milestone
nodes.desc: System shall save the journey milestone upon successful validation.
controls: System shall save the journey milestone upon successful validation.

nodes.label: Order Submission and Migration
nodes.desc: Agent shall be able to submit the order.
controls: System shall submit the order to downstream systems for backend provisioning and Activation after Payment is successful.
System shall terminate the postpaid connection after the prepaid activation and send to downstream systems.
System shall update the inventory for SIM/MSISDN.

nodes.label: Customer Notification at Order Submission
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: All Orders View from Customer 360
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Order Completion
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Record Ticket Update
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Feedback Survey
nodes.desc: Reuse Requirement of Mobility Postpaid Activation

nodes.label: Record Ticket Closure
nodes.desc: System shall automatically mark the Trouble ticket as Closed and close all Activities of the Trouble Ticket once Customer Feedback link is sent.

nodes.label: Customer Notification — Completion
nodes.desc: System shall send acknowledgement on order completion to customer through the selected mode (Email/SMS). System shall send notification on order completion to all the MSISDNs which are available under the QID. E.g. if Customer account with QID has 5 contacts/MSISDNs active then notification will be sent to all 5 MSISDNs for the successful activation of any MSISDN.

flows.label: Return to payment summary for re-attempt
